title: Analytics Engine: 24h Delta Calculator, Aggregator & Leaderboard Rankings
description: Implement the analytics layer that computes daily deltas from snapshot comparisons, aggregates artist-level daily streams across catalogs, and produces ranked leaderboard data. Includes negative delta clamping, time-series data preparation for trajectory charts, and top gainer track computation.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/analytics/delta.ts exports computeTrackDeltas(date?: SnapshotDate): TrackDelta[] — compares today vs yesterday playcounts, clamps negative deltas to 0
src/lib/analytics/delta.ts exports computeArtistDeltas(date?: SnapshotDate): ArtistDelta[] — compares today vs yesterday monthly listeners and followers
src/lib/analytics/delta.ts handles missing previous-day data gracefully (new tracks/artists return 0 delta, not error)
src/lib/analytics/aggregator.ts exports aggregateArtistDailyStreams(date?: SnapshotDate): ArtistDailyAggregate[] — sums all track deltas per artist, identifies top track per artist
src/lib/analytics/aggregator.ts exports getArtistTrajectory(spotifyId, metric, startDate, endDate): ArtistTrajectory — returns time-series data points for charts
src/lib/analytics/aggregator.ts exports getArtistDetail(spotifyId): ArtistDetailView — assembles full artist detail view with recent tracks and trajectory data
src/lib/analytics/leaderboard.ts exports getLeaderboard(query: LeaderboardQuery): LeaderboardResponse — sorted, paginated artist rankings
src/lib/analytics/leaderboard.ts exports getTopGainerTracks(query: TopGainerTracksQuery): TopGainerTracksResponse — scene-wide top gaining tracks
All functions use parameterized SQL queries (no string concatenation) to prevent SQL injection
All functions import types exclusively from src/types/contracts.ts
Leaderboard supports all 5 sort keys: totalDailyStreams, monthlyListeners, listenerDelta, followers, topTrackStreams
